item.subject: science
item.stem: Meena and Arjun measure the length of the same study table at home using their own handspans. Meena counts 8 handspans and Arjun counts 10 handspans. Which statement correctly explains why their answers are different?

options.A: Arjun counted more handspans, so the table must be longer when he measures it.
options.B: Their answers in centimetres would also be different, because a centimetre is a different length for each student.
options.C: Meena is shorter than Arjun, so she must have counted fewer handspans.
options.D: Handspans differ in size from person to person, so the same table can give different counts.
